name: weekly-schedule-card
description: Visual weekly schedule card for Home Assistant

scripts.check: npm run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');for(const f of ['dist/weekly-schedule-card.js','dist/weekly-schedule-view-card.js']){const c=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');if(!c.startsWith('(function ()')){console.error('FAIL '+f+' is not IIFE');process.exit(1)}console.log('OK '+f+' '+c.length+'b')}"
